Build publication-ready tables from a timecoda summary

Source: R/pub_ready.R
pub_ready.Rd

Turns the object returned by a timecoda summary() method into a named list of gt::gt() tables, with the numbers arranged in the layout of a manuscript or report table.

Usage

pub_ready(x, digits = 2, p_flag = 0.05)

Arguments

x

A summary object from a timecoda summary() method: a summary_compD (from summary.compD()), a summary_comp_iv (from summary.comp_iv()) or a summary_realloc (from summary.realloc()).

digits

Number of decimal places in the rendered table: a single non-negative whole number. Default 2.

p_flag

Significance threshold below which the summary_realloc table flags an effect with * (relative output only). A single number from 0 to 1; default 0.05. At 0 no effect is flagged. The other summary types ignore it.

Value

A named list of gt::gt() tables, one per table the summary carries, with no entry for a table it lacks.

summary_compD

desc (each part's arithmetic Mean \(\pm\) SD of the original data, before zero imputation and closure, alongside its geometric mean on the closed composition and, when the composition is not already closed to proportions or percentages, its share of the total; each column header names its scale) and var_matrix.

summary_comp_iv

effects (the omnibus composition row followed by one "part vs remaining" row per part, with the effect, its confidence interval and p-value; a per-category model adds an Outcome column and a moderated fit a per-part moderation p-value).

summary_realloc

effects (one row per reallocation pair, with the effect, flagged * below p_flag, and its confidence interval under a column spanner for each delta; a by grouping or a multinomial outcome adds a column).

See also

summary.compD(), summary.comp_iv() and summary.realloc() for the underlying summaries.

Examples

cd <- declare_composition(timeuse, c("MVPA", "LPA", "SB", "SPT"),
                          closure = 1440, units = "min/day")
s <- summary(cd)
pub_ready(s)$desc
